title: 第25章 山中人罢了第26章 赋税
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
三妖一看来人，眼珠子都快瞪出来了。
虎妖猛地想起那“和众”之计，蛇妖也反应过来那“离间”之谋，两头大妖对视一眼，瞬间恍然大悟！
“是你这老鬼！”虎妖气得呕出一口老血，指着陶潜破口大骂，“好个歹毒的老畜生，你竟把我们全算计了！”
蛇妖也气得浑身发抖，吐着信子嘶吼：“千刀万剐的老阴比！老子做鬼也不放过你！”
“做鬼？恐怕你们连做鬼的资格都没有。”陶潜冷笑一声，浑浊的老眼中杀机毕露，大袖一挥，“今日老道便替天行道，荡平这枯骨岭，拿你们的狗命来祭老道的道场！”
“跟他拼了！”三头大妖自知必死，竟不知哪来的力气，齐齐暴起。
虎妖化作一阵腥风，蛇妖喷出漫天毒雾，熊妖抡起大棍，呈品字形朝陶潜疯狂扑杀而来。
陶潜大喝一声，双手猛地捏了个法诀，浑身清气冲天而起，“法天象地，长！”
话音未落，只听得“轰隆”一声巨响，陶潜那干瘪的身躯迎风暴涨，须臾间竟化作一尊百米高的恐怖法象！头顶云霄，脚踏山岳，浑身金光璀璨，宛如远古魔神降世。
那根桃木拐杖也随之化作一根擎天巨柱，搅动风云。
三妖在那百米法象面前，好似三只可笑的蝼蚁，冲锋的势头戛然而止，吓得肝胆俱裂，连逃跑的念头都生不出来。
“死！”陶潜声如洪钟，震得山摇地动。
他抡起那擎天巨柱般的拐杖，带着毁灭天地的威压，照着三妖当头砸下！
“砰——！”
一声惊天动地的巨响，整座东山都被砸塌了半边，乱石穿空，尘土飞扬。
那不可一世的虎大王、吞云大王和东山憨熊，连惨叫都没来得及发出一声，便被这一拐杖连皮带骨砸成了三滩肉泥，神魂俱灭！
那百米高的法天象地一收，陶潜重又化作个干瘪老头，稳稳落回地面。
周围那些个蛤蟆精、野猪怪、长虫妖，本就死伤大半，如今见自家大王被人一棍子碾碎，吓得屎尿齐流，发一声喊，连滚带爬地就要往深山里钻。
“想走？都留下吧！”陶潜冷笑一声，桃木拐杖往地上一杵，那百十个青面獠牙的重甲阴兵得了号令，化作一道道黑风扑杀上去。
长戈大戟一通乱剁，直杀得血肉横飞，惨叫连天。

不过半炷香的功夫，留在原地的妖兵便被砍瓜切菜般杀了个干净。
有几个腿脚快的钻进地缝、跳进暗河跑了，陶潜也懒得去追。
如今这枯骨岭的毒瘤已除，地盘空了出来，只要把这“仙山”的名气传出去，自然有求仙问道的香客源源不断地找上门来。
山中无岁月，转眼便是一年。
content_en:
When the three demons looked at the person, their eyes nearly popped out.
The tiger demon suddenly remembered the plan of "harmony", and the snake demon also realized the plan of "estrangement". The two big demons looked at each other, and they suddenly realized!
"It's you old ghost!" The tiger demon was so angry that he vomited a mouthful of old blood, pointed at Tao Qian and yelled, "What a vicious old beast, you actually plotted against us all!"
The snake demon was also trembling with anger, spitting out the letter and roaring: "Old Yinbi will be cut into pieces with a thousand cuts! Even if I become a ghost, I won't let you go!"
"Being a ghost? I'm afraid you are not even qualified to be a ghost." Tao Qian sneered, his turbid old eyes were full of murderous intent, and he waved his sleeves, "Today, the old Taoist will do justice for God, level this Withered Bone Ridge, and use your dog lives to sacrifice the old Taoist's dojo!"
"Fight him!" The three big demons knew that they were bound to die, but they didn't know where they got the strength from, and they all burst into violence.
The tiger demon turned into a gust of fishy wind, the snake demon spewed out poisonous mist that filled the sky, and the bear demon swung his big stick and came towards Tao Qian in a pin-shaped formation to attack him crazily.
Tao Qian shouted loudly, squeezed a magic formula with both hands, and his whole body was filled with pure energy, "The magic in the sky is like the earth, long!"
Before he finished speaking, there was only a loud "bang" sound, and Tao Qian's withered body swelled up against the storm, and in an instant it turned into a terrifying statue of a hundred meters high! With the clouds above his head and the mountains under his feet, his whole body was covered in golden light, just like the ancient demon god coming to the world.
The mahogany crutch also turned into a giant pillar, stirring up the wind and clouds.
The three demons looked like three ridiculous ants in front of the 100-meter-long Dharma elephant. Their charging momentum came to an abrupt halt, and they were so frightened that they could not even think of escaping.
"Death!" Tao Qian's voice was like a bell, shaking the mountains and the earth.
He swung the crutch like a giant pillar, and with the pressure of destroying the world, he smashed it down on the three demons' heads!
"Bang——!"
There was an earth-shaking loud noise, and half of the entire Dongshan Mountain was smashed down, with rocks piercing the air and dust flying.
The arrogant Tiger King, Tunyun King and Dongshan Hanxiong didn't even have time to scream, before they were smashed into three pools of flesh by this crutch, including their skin and bones, and their souls were destroyed!
As soon as the 100-meter-high law of heaven and earth retracted, Tao Qianzhong turned into a withered old man and fell steadily back to the ground.
Most of the toad spirits, wild boar monsters, and insect monsters around them were already dead and injured. Now that they saw their king being crushed to pieces with a stick, they were so frightened that they urinated like urine. They screamed, rolled and crawled on the ground, and tried to crawl deep into the mountains.
"Want to leave? Stay here!" Tao Qian sneered and punched the ground with his mahogany crutch. The hundreds of green-faced and fanged heavy-armored Yin soldiers got the order and turned into black winds to attack them.
The Chang Ge spurge chopped him randomly, killing him until his flesh and blood flew everywhere, and he screamed in agony.
In just half a stick of incense, the remaining demon soldiers were killed as if they were chopping melons and vegetables.
A few quickly got into the cracks in the ground, jumped into the underground river and ran away. Tao Qian didn't bother to chase them.
Now that the cancer in Dry Bone Ridge has been eliminated and the land is freed up, as long as the reputation of this "fairy mountain" spreads, pilgrims who seek immortality will naturally come to the door in a steady stream.
There are no years in the mountains, and one year passes in the blink of an eye.
